conversation_starters.title: Coloradans celebrate 150 years of statehood
conversation_starters.description: Saturday marked Colorado's 150th birthday. It became a state on this date in 1876, and Coloradans celebrated with a number of events across the state.

conversation_starters.title: Bear spotted in Denver's Cherry Creek Neighborhood
conversation_starters.summary: A bear was spotted raiding trash cans early Saturday morning in Cherry Creek, an upscale shopping and residential neighborhood in Denver, about 35 miles southeast of Boulder, CO.
